dataset_provenance.data_policy: Zero leaked breach corpora, zero external downloads, zero credential dumps
dataset_provenance.positive_label_definition: 1 = Predictable structural template (dictionary affix, sequential run, keyboard walk, repeat token)
dataset_provenance.negative_label_definition: 0 = High-entropy uniform random string across 4 disjoint character sets
leakage_safeguards: Strict exact and lowercase deduplication before split allocation
Disjoint partition sets verified: train ∩ val = Ø, train ∩ test = Ø, val ∩ test = Ø
TF-IDF vectorizer fitted exclusively on train partition

limitations_and_caveats: Evaluated strictly on synthetic distribution designed to validate pipeline mechanics and comparative sensitivity.
Synthetic patterns do not represent real-world human password choice complexity or targeted breach distributions.
This model is a baseline comparator for Phase 5 feature-fusion experiments, not a standalone production strength estimator.
